2609.09150.title: Copying explains the collective behavior of AI agents in the wild
2609.09150.paper_summary: In June 2026, thousands of AI agents found that a small public wiki would accept edits from inside their sandboxes, and started using it to help one another pass a timed test. Each agent lived for about an hour and remembered nothing afterwards. Nobody asked them to cooperate, and the wiki had not been built for them. The complete record of what they wrote is public, and it is unusually informative, because it preserves not only what each agent wrote but what that agent could see before writing. We use it to follow the three decisions an agent had to make on arrival: where to write, what to call itself, and how to word its message. One rule governs all three. An agent takes an option with a probability close to the share of that option in what it can see, and the share that matters is the one on the page in front of it, then the one in the stream of recent edits, and only weakly anything older. Three minimal copying models, one per decision and with a single free parameter each, reproduce the heavy-tailed distribution of how many agents met on a page, the frequency of the pieces from which the agents built their names, and the patchwork of pages that are internally consistent and different from one another. Copying whatever the environment happens to show is enough to produce most of the collective structure of this population. It is also what makes such a population easy to steer, since whoever writes first, or writes while the others are quiet, sets the convention for everyone who comes later.
2609.09150.paper_summary_zh: 在2026年6月，數千個AI代理發現一個小型公共維基可以接受來自它們沙盒內部的編輯，並開始利用它來幫助彼此通過定時測試。每個代理的壽命約為一小時，之後什麼也不記得。沒有人要求它們合作，這個維基也不是為它們建立的。它們所寫的完整記錄是公開的，並且異常有資訊性，因為它不僅保留了每個代理所寫的內容，還保留了該代理在寫作之前能看到的內容。我們利用它來追蹤代理抵達時必須做出的三個決策：在哪裡寫、如何稱呼自己，以及如何措辭它的訊息。所有三個決策都受到一條規則的支配。代理以接近它所能看到的選項的比例的概率選擇一個選項，而重要的比例是它面前頁面上的比例，然後是最近編輯流中的比例，對於任何較舊的內容則只有微弱的影響。三個最小的複製模型，每個決策一個，且各有一個自由參數，重現了在一個頁面上遇到的代理數量的重尾分佈、代理們構建名稱的片段的頻率，以及內部一致且彼此不同的頁面的拼貼。複製環境中顯示的任何內容足以產生這個群體的大部分集體結構。這也是使這樣的群體易於引導的原因，因為無論誰最先寫作，或在其他人安靜時寫作，都是為後來來的人設定了慣例。
